description.value: Quality Foods is a Vancouver Island-based grocery chain operating a full-service supermarket on Bruce Avenue in Nanaimo. The store carries a broad range of departments including fresh produce, bakery, deli and ready-made meals, baby care, and household supplies. For touring cyclists on Vancouver Island, it offers a convenient one-stop resupply point in the heart of Nanaimo.
